verdict.rationale: Clara's own marketing says it automates expense approvals, so it has some approval capability, but nothing in the evidence describes how approval workflows are built. The "escalate" wording in clara-docs-23 is about budget insights, not escalating stalled approvers, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: configurable multi-step approval chains (manager, budget owner, finance), approver delegation, escalation or timeouts when approvers sit on requests, any first-party workflow documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: Automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance for full visibility and reduced manual work
